CAC ₹427 → ₹768, ROAS 6.6 → 3.6 — that's the classic signature of saturating your best intent. The cheap, high-intent audience was a finite pool; you drained it, and the extra budget is now chasing people who were never going to convert as easily. The trap is reading this as "scale harder." More budget into the same pool just keeps pushing CAC up. The lever is to create new demand before you add more spend — new audiences, new creative angles, a second channel — so you're filling the funnel wider, not deeper into exhaustion.

Caveat: 8 weeks of organic also catches seasonality, so confirm the CAC climb is steady week-on-week and not a festive dip. But the shape here is saturation, not a malfunction.
